payload.subject: Re: Reschedule needed
payload.body: thanks for the heads up. i don't have my calendar details on hand right now, but could we look at options the following week? let me know what's available and i'll confirm a time that works.

payload.rationale: No calendar or availability info was in memory, so I avoided inventing specific times and kept the reply open-ended.

parsed.rationale: Drafted a reply asking the office for options since no availability data was provided, avoiding invented commitments.
